title: Room Four Rings Twice  (四号房响铃两声)

segments.t: 星期天午后的菩提树庭院客栈安静惬意，前台的黄铜呼叫铃突然连续响了两声清脆的铃音。汉娜和格雷厄姆从预订登记簿前抬起头，正好看见伊芙琳手里抱着一本旧旧的绿布封面书走下木楼梯。请先完整听一遍对话。
Ring ring on a quiet Sunday — that double ring is definitely Room Four.
Right on cue! Look who is coming down the stairs with a green book!
I pressed the bell once upstairs, Graham, and your friendly wire rang twice as usual.
If Room Four ever rang only once, madam, I would think it was broken.
Here is the cloth bound garden herb book from the second hand bookshop shelf on Linden Street!
Look at the gold leaf stamped on the faded green cover: Courtyard Herbs and Blossoms.
Check inside the front cover first — old neighbors always wrote their street number there.
Good eye, Graham! Penciled in the corner is our exact house number from thirty years ago!
This book actually belonged to Arthur and his aunt before it reached the lending shelf!
Turn the pages gently over the desk blotter so nothing dry slips onto the floor.
Wait — the book falls open all by itself near chapter seven on summer mint!
Let us carry it straight to Tessa in Room Nine before anyone breathes too hard!
现在让我们回到前台，逐句细看这一幕的表达。
Ring ring on a quiet Sunday — that double ring is definitely Room Four.
“安静的星期天，叮铃叮铃——那两声铃响肯定是四号房。”格雷厄姆头也不抬就听出了动静。注意这里的 ring 用作名词，表示“铃响声”，前面加上形容词修饰：
that double ring
后面的 definitely 意思是“肯定、无疑”；拼写时要留意中间是 -ite-，而不是 -ate-，尽管读起来很像。
Right on cue! Look who is coming down the stairs with a green book!
“来得正是时候！快看是谁抱着一本绿皮书走下楼梯！”汉娜恰好在那一刻看到伊芙琳出现。Right on cue 源自戏剧用语：cue 就是提示演员上场或接台词的“信号”。
Right on cue!
还要留意 come down the stairs：英语习惯在动词 come 后面加上表示方向的副词 down，组合成“走下来”，不像中文一个“下”字就概括了。
I pressed the bell once upstairs, Graham, and your friendly wire rang twice as usual.
“格雷厄姆，我在楼上只按了一次铃，但你那根好心的小电线像往常一样响了两声。”伊芙琳打趣着客栈这根爱自作主张的铃线。英语表示次数时有专门的词：once 是“一次”，twice 是“两次”。
rang twice as usual.
rang 是 ring 的不规则过去式（ring, rang, rung）。另外，as usual 意思是“像往常一样”，别和表示“通常、一般”的 usually 混用。
If Room Four ever rang only once, madam, I would think it was broken.
“夫人，要是四号房哪天只响了一声，我反倒会以为它坏了呢。”表达非真实或假设的情境时，英语在 if 从句里用一般过去时（rang）：
If Room Four ever rang only once,
主句则用“would + 动词原形”表示虚拟结果：I would think（我会以为）。madam 是非常正式礼貌的尊称，重音在第一音节 /ˈmædəm/。
Here is the cloth bound garden herb book from the second hand bookshop shelf on Linden Street!
“这就是菩提树街二手书店书架上那本布面装订的园艺香草书！”在英语里，一连串名词或修饰语叠在一起时，核心词往往在最后，理解时可以从后往前看：
the cloth bound garden herb book
second hand bookshop（二手书店）也是同样的结构。顺便记住：bookshop（或 bookstore）才是“书店”，而 library 指的是“图书馆”，不要弄混了。
Look at the gold leaf stamped on the faded green cover: Courtyard Herbs and Blossoms.
“快看褪色的绿布封面上压印的金箔字：《庭院香草与花木》。”汉娜念出了封面上的烫金书名。gold leaf 不是树叶，而是装帧古书常用的极薄“金箔”。
stamped on the faded green cover:
faded 源自动词 fade（褪色），用来形容颜色因年代久远而发白变浅。cover 指书的“封面”。
Check inside the front cover first — old neighbors always wrote their street number there.
“先看看前封面内页——以前的老邻居总爱把门牌号写在那儿。”格雷厄姆分享了一个老习惯。在 check inside the front cover first 这类祈使句中，副词 first 常常放在句尾：
Check inside the front cover first
另外，neighbors 这里用的是美式拼写；英式英语会多一个 u，写作 neighbours。
Good eye, Graham! Penciled in the corner is our exact house number from thirty years ago!
“好眼力，格雷厄姆！用铅笔写在角落里的，正是我们三十年前的门牌号！”Good eye! 用来称赞别人观察仔细。接下来这句话用了一个倒装语序，把分词短语提前来制造悬念：
Penciled in the corner
pencil 在这里用作动词，意思是“用铅笔写”。表达“三十年前”时，英语把 ago 放在时间长度后面：thirty years ago。
This book actually belonged to Arthur and his aunt before it reached the lending shelf!
“其实这本书在送到借阅架之前，原本是属于亚瑟和他姑妈的！”汉娜惊喜地把线索串了起来。这里要留意一个容易望文生义的词：
actually belonged to Arthur
actually 的意思是“实际上、其实”，并不是“目前”（目前是 currently）。表示“属于某人”用 belong to，后面固定跟介词 to。
Turn the pages gently over the desk blotter so nothing dry slips onto the floor.
“在吸墨桌垫上方轻轻翻动书页，免得有干掉的东西滑落到地板上。”格雷厄姆一如既往地小心谨慎。表示“翻页”用 turn the pages，加上 gently 表示“轻柔地”：
Turn the pages gently
slip 是“滑落”，onto 表示“落到……表面上”。desk blotter 指的是垫在书桌上保护桌面、吸墨用的“桌垫”。
Wait — the book falls open all by itself near chapter seven on summer mint!
“等等——这本书到了第七章‘夏日薄荷’那儿居然自己翻开了！”看来有什么东西把这一页夹了好些年。书“自己摊开”在英语里说 falls open：
falls open all by itself
by itself 表示“独自、靠自己”，前面加上 all 更强调“完全自动”。换成人的时候，可以说 by myself 或 by yourself。
Let us carry it straight to Tessa in Room Nine before anyone breathes too hard!
“趁还没人喘大气，咱们赶紧把它直接拿去九号房找泰莎吧！”汉娜提议立刻行动。let us（口语常缩写为 let's）用来提出“让我们一起……”的建议：
carry it straight to Tessa
straight 在这里不是“笔直”，而是“径直、直接”。另外，动词 breathe（呼吸）的元音发长音，结尾 th 发浊音；注意别和名词 breath 混为一谈。现在让我们按正常语速再完整听一遍这一幕。
Ring ring on a quiet Sunday — that double ring is definitely Room Four.
Right on cue! Look who is coming down the stairs with a green book!
I pressed the bell once upstairs, Graham, and your friendly wire rang twice as usual.
If Room Four ever rang only once, madam, I would think it was broken.
Here is the cloth bound garden herb book from the second hand bookshop shelf on Linden Street!
Look at the gold leaf stamped on the faded green cover: Courtyard Herbs and Blossoms.
Check inside the front cover first — old neighbors always wrote their street number there.
Good eye, Graham! Penciled in the corner is our exact house number from thirty years ago!
This book actually belonged to Arthur and his aunt before it reached the lending shelf!
Turn the pages gently over the desk blotter so nothing dry slips onto the floor.
Wait — the book falls open all by itself near chapter seven on summer mint!
Let us carry it straight to Tessa in Room Nine before anyone breathes too hard!
绿布植物书的封面内页上用铅笔写着三十年前的门牌号，而且它刚好自动翻开在薄荷那一章。我们一会儿见！
See you soon!
